index.html.note: The books list page. The list is empty in the HTML; js/books.js fills it from the API using the <template> card.

book.html.note: One book's page. js/book.js reads ?slug= from the address and fills in the article.

js/config.js.note: The only setting: the address of your WordPress site.

js/wordpress.js.note: The one place that talks to WordPress. Every book request asks for the `acf` fields with acf_format=standard, so the cover comes back as an object with its URL and alt text.

js/books.js.note: Fetches books and genres in parallel, then copies the card template once per book. ACF sends `pages` as a string here, hence Number().

js/book.js.note: Finds the book by its slug and fills in the page, using the cover's own alt text from ACF.

css/style.css.note: Plain CSS: a grid of book cards, and a two-column book page that stacks on phones.

README.md.note: What the WordPress side needs (CPT UI + ACF), and how to run it.
